description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/childcare_swap_raw.xlsx containing babysitting session data for 4 families (Miller, Chen, Rodriguez, Patel). Sheet 'Sessions' has columns: Date, WatcherFamily, ChildFamily, Hours, Notes. Sheet 'Summary' is blank. Create formulas in the Summary sheet to calculate: (1) Hours Given by each family (SUMIF where family is WatcherFamily), (2) Hours Received by each family (SUMIF where family is ChildFamily), (3) Net Balance (Given - Received). Apply conditional formatting to highlight imbalances > ±3 hours. Add a cell calculating the maximum absolute imbalance. Save the spreadsheet.
